title: Pong
description: A ball bounces through the field and is hit back by the paddle. Move the paddle with W/S or the up/down arrows.
tasks: Start with Run and keep the ball in play.
Make the ball faster when it hits the paddle.
Count the hits in a text at the top of the field.
Reset the ball when it leaves the field on the left.
Add a second paddle on the right side.
